<thought>Generate a list of up to 40 nitride compositions, retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition within 0.3 eV/atom above the hull, and consolidate the results into a single JSON file. The batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool will store individual JSON files in a specified directory; then I’ll list those files, map each composition to its file, and use consolidate_polymorph_datasets to produce the final combined dataset. Finally, I’ll output the path to the consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "BN", "Si3N4", "TiN", "ZrN", "HfN", "CrN", "MoN",
        "VN", "NbN", "TaN", "ScN", "YN", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2", "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2",
        "Li3N", "Na3N", "K3N", "Be3N2", "Zn3N2", "Cd3N2", "SiN", "GeN", "SnN",
        "PbN", "FeN", "CoN", "NiN", "CuN", "AgN", "AuN", "PtN", "PdN", "RhN",
        "IrN", "OsN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_3/polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
